From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Subject: Skyline / AWS - SA availability & demo cadence

Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for agreeing to a joint technical walkthrough for Skyline’s integration with Redwood. Goal: 45-minute co-sell demo for Skyline’s platform (customer-facing demo) + 30-minute post-demo ops run-through (internal) the same day so we can hand off to Customer Success.

Proposed session blocks (PST):
- Option A: Tue 2027-02-22 09:00–09:45 (demo) + 10:00–10:30 (ops)
- Option B: Tue 2027-02-22 11:00–11:45 (demo) + 12:00–12:30 (ops)
- Option C: Wed 2027-02-23 08:00–08:45 (demo) + 09:00–09:30 (ops)

Ask: can Priya or an AWS SA join the demo and be on the post-demo ops call to confirm any account-specific networking/permission nuances? Marcus and Karthik from Redwood will run the demo. Noah from Acme (customer) hopes to attend — Alex, can you confirm his availability?

I’ve attached an updated runbook (Skyline-demo-runbook-v2.pdf) and a placeholder calendar invite; I’ll update once we lock the time.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Partnerships (Marketplace) | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachment: Skyline-demo-runbook-v2.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (text/calendar)
